type.description: Type of discount: percentage off or fixed monetary amount

value.description: The discount amount (e.g., 20 for 20% or 10.00 for £10 fixed)

is_active.description: Whether this discount code is currently active

expires_at.description: Optional expiry date for the discount code

min_purchase_amount.description: Minimum total purchase amount required for the discount to apply

max_usage_count.description: Maximum number of times this code can be used (globally for general codes, per-organization for org-specific codes)

current_usage_count.description: Current usage count for global codes only (organization-specific codes use DiscountCodeUsage entity)

program_tag.description: Optional: program tag if this discount is specific to a program

organization_id.description: Optional: Reference to Organization entity if this discount is exclusive to one organization. If null, it's a global discount available to all organizations.

member_id.description: Optional: Reference to Member entity if this discount is exclusive to one member. Mutually exclusive with organization_id, role_id, member_group_id.

role_id.description: Optional: Reference to Role entity if this discount is restricted to members with this role. Mutually exclusive with organization_id, member_id, member_group_id.

member_group_id.description: Optional: Reference to MemberGroup entity if this discount is restricted to members in this group. Mutually exclusive with organization_id, member_id, role_id.

event_id.description: Optional: Reference to Event entity if this discount is restricted to a specific event. Independent of program_tag and target type restrictions.
